scene_purpose: Establish human scale and vulnerability before the event.
main_subject: An isolated early-20th-century hand-hewn log cabin in a small clearing, thin chimney smoke, dense taiga behind.

camera.angle: Cinematic wide shot, slightly elevated (~4-6 m above ground), looking gently down at the cabin
camera.composition: Cabin off-center left on the lower-third line; tall conifer right edge frames the shot; misty forested valley recedes upper-right; smoke column links cabin to sky.

lighting.direction: Soft diffused daylight from upper right, mild warm bias
lighting.intensity_and_character: Overcast-to-soft-sun morning; gentle shadow under the eaves; smoke and valley mist catch the light.

foreground_elements: grass and low shrubs around the clearing
midground_elements: log cabin with shingle roof, small windows, stone/clay chimney
materials: hand-hewn logs with visible grain and chinking
environmental_details: period-correct construction (no sawn lumber, no metal roof)
animation_opportunities: smoke drift (particles with slow fall negative = rise)
must_preserve: cabin silhouette and human scale against forest
can_simplify: log detail to vertex-coloured cylinders + normal-ish noise (paint() pattern from nature.js)
background forest to instanced far trees

engine_mapping.cabin: extend scenes/lib/world.js homestead group: stacked CylinderGeometry logs, vertex-painted bark colour (#4a3a2e range), ConeGeometry-free shingle roof from thin BoxGeometry rows
engine_mapping.smoke: particles({ n: 300, additive: false, fall: -0.4, drift: 0.3, color: '#c9c9c9', opacity: 0.25 }) rising column
engine_mapping.light: sunLight '#ffe8c8' intensity 2, high softness via large shadow normalBias; HemisphereLight fill
